title: 运营分析
description: PAP-172：活跃、留存、漏斗与跳出、检索、文献使用（COUNTER）、数据质量。只读 ClickHouse 的 ADS 小表，口径见 docs/patra/specs/2026-11-02-analytics-dashboard-design.md。

panels.title: 末日 DAU
panels.description: 时间范围最后一天的日活（DAU）：当天来过的独立的人。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT argMax(dau, day) AS DAU FROM (
  SELECT day, sum(dau) AS dau FROM ads_daily_active_latest
  WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw}) GROUP BY day)

panels.title: 末日 MAU
panels.description: 时间范围最后一天的月活（MAU）：含当天往前 30 天里来过的独立的人（滚动窗口）。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT argMax(mau, day) AS MAU FROM (
  SELECT day, sum(mau) AS mau FROM ads_daily_active_latest
  WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw}) GROUP BY day)

panels.title: 黏性（DAU ÷ MAU）
panels.description: 时间范围内每天 DAU ÷ MAU 的平均：一个月里平均每人来几天的比例。工具类 10%～20% 常见。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avgOrNull(dau / mau) AS stickiness FROM (
  SELECT day, sum(dau) AS dau, sum(mau) AS mau FROM ads_daily_active_latest
  WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw}) GROUP BY day HAVING mau > 0)

panels.title: 次日留存（最近一个同期群）
panels.description: 范围内最后一个已满 1 天的同期群里，恰好第 2 天又来的人占比（经典 N 日留存）。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT argMax(returned / people, cohort_day) AS d1_rate FROM (
  SELECT cohort_day, sum(d1) AS returned, sum(cohort_size) AS people FROM ads_cohort_retention_latest
  WHERE cohort_day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw}) AND d1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cohort_day HAVING people > 0)

panels.title: 无结果率
panels.description: 结果数为 0 的检索占比（按上方「检索模式」）。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(zero_result_searches) / sum(searches) AS zero_rate FROM ads_daily_search_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw}) AND mode IN (${mode:singlequote}) HAVING sum(searches) > 0

panels.title: 跳出率
panels.description: 只看了一个页面就离开的会话 ÷ 有页面浏览的会话（经典定义）。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sumIf(sessions, single_page) / sumIf(sessions, funnel_level >= 1) AS bounce_rate FROM ads_daily_sessions_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND ('${traffic}' = 'all' OR session_kind = 'human') AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw}) HAVING sumIf(sessions, funnel_level >= 1) > 0

panels.title: DAU / WAU / MAU
panels.description: 日活 / 周活 / 月活：当天、含当天往前 7 天、往前 30 天里来过的独立的人（滚动窗口）。「人」登录按账号、未登录按设备。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time, sum(dau) AS DAU, sum(wau) AS WAU, sum(mau) AS MAU
FROM ads_daily_active_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw})
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: 黏性（DAU ÷ MAU）
panels.description: 每天的 DAU ÷ MAU。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time, sum(dau) / sum(mau) AS stickiness
FROM ads_daily_active_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw})
GROUP BY day HAVING sum(mau) > 0 ORDER BY day

panels.title: 新增访客
panels.description: 这一天第一次出现的人（之前从没来过）。登录前用设备、登录后用账号的同一个人只算一次新增（认回）。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(cohort_day, 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time, sum(cohort_size) AS new_people
FROM ads_cohort_retention_latest
WHERE cohort_day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw})
GROUP BY cohort_day ORDER BY cohort_day

panels.title: 同期群留存
panels.description: 每行是一批在同一天第一次来的人（同期群），各列是恰好在第 1 / 7 / 30 天又来的比例（经典 N 日留存）。第 N 天还没过完的格子留空，不是 0。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cohort_day AS `首日`, sum(cohort_size) AS `人数`,
       round(100 * sum(d1) / sum(cohort_size), 1) AS `次日 %`,
       round(100 * sum(d7) / sum(cohort_size), 1) AS `7 日 %`,
       round(100 * sum(d30) / sum(cohort_size), 1) AS `30 日 %`
FROM ads_cohort_retention_latest
WHERE cohort_day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw})
GROUP BY cohort_day HAVING sum(cohort_size) > 0 ORDER BY cohort_day DESC

panels.title: 次日 / 7 日留存率
panels.description: 按首日画的次日、7 日留存率。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(cohort_day, 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time,
       sum(d1) / sum(cohort_size) AS `次日`, sum(d7) / sum(cohort_size) AS `7 日`
FROM ads_cohort_retention_latest
WHERE cohort_day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw})
GROUP BY cohort_day HAVING sum(cohort_size) > 0 ORDER BY cohort_day

panels.title: 漏斗：访问 → 检索 → 点检索结果 → 文献页 → 读全文
panels.description: 一个会话里按顺序走到第几步（ClickHouse windowFunnel，窗口 30 分钟）。第 1 步「访问」= 会话里有页面浏览；读全文含下载 PDF。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT step AS `步骤`, sessions AS `会话数`,
       round(100 * sessions / nullIf(first_value(sessions) OVER (ORDER BY n), 0), 1) AS `占第 1 步 %`,
       round(100 * sessions / nullIf(lagInFrame(sessions, 1, sessions) OVER (ORDER BY n ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0), 1) AS `占上一步 %`
FROM (
  SELECT n, step, sum(if(funnel_level >= n, sessions, 0)) AS sessions
  FROM ads_daily_sessions_latest
  ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] AS n, ['访问', '检索', '点检索结果', '文献页', '读全文'] AS step
  WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND ('${traffic}' = 'all' OR session_kind = 'human') AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw})
  GROUP BY n, step)
ORDER BY n

panels.title: 跳出率
panels.description: 只看一个页面就离开的会话占比。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time,
       sumIf(sessions, single_page) / sumIf(sessions, funnel_level >= 1) AS bounce_rate
FROM ads_daily_sessions_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND ('${traffic}' = 'all' OR session_kind = 'human') AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw})
GROUP BY day HAVING sumIf(sessions, funnel_level >= 1) > 0 ORDER BY day

panels.title: 会话构成（不受「含爬虫」影响）
panels.description: 每天三类会话数：真人（有浏览器事件、无爬虫事件）、爬虫（有一条被标为爬虫）、不跑脚本（只有服务端事件）。后两类不进对外数字（埋点方案 §6.5）。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time,
       sumIf(sessions, session_kind = 'human') AS `真人`,
       sumIf(sessions, session_kind = 'bot') AS `爬虫`,
       sumIf(sessions, session_kind = 'no_script') AS `不跑脚本`
FROM ads_daily_sessions_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw})
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: 无结果率与检索点击率
panels.description: 无结果率 = 结果数为 0 的检索占比；检索点击率 = 至少点了一个结果的检索占比（Algolia 口径）。按上方「检索模式」，默认只看普通检索。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time,
       sum(zero_result_searches) / sum(searches) AS `无结果率`,
       sum(clicked_searches) / sum(searches) AS `检索点击率`
FROM ads_daily_search_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw}) AND mode IN (${mode:singlequote})
GROUP BY day HAVING sum(searches) > 0 ORDER BY day

panels.title: 无结果词排行（前 50）
panels.description: 普通检索里结果为 0 的检索词（去首尾空白、小写、连续空白合并），按次数排序；人数跨天不重复算。用来决定补什么数据或同义词。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT term AS `检索词`, sum(searches) AS `次数`, uniqExactMerge(people) AS `人数`
FROM ads_daily_zero_result_terms_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw})
GROUP BY term ORDER BY `次数` DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Investigations 与 Requests
panels.description: COUNTER 5.1：Investigations = 任何查看（文献页、读全文、下载 PDF、收藏），Requests = 读全文或下载 PDF。Unique 按会话去重；Total 同一人同一篇 30 秒内只算一次。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time,
       sum(total_investigations) AS `Total Item Investigations`,
       sum(unique_investigations) AS `Unique Item Investigations`,
       sum(total_requests) AS `Total Item Requests`,
       sum(unique_requests) AS `Unique Item Requests`
FROM ads_daily_counter_items_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw})
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Unique Item Requests 前 20 篇
panels.description: 时间范围内被读全文最多的 20 篇，点文献 ID 打开门户的文献页。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toString(article_id) AS article_id, sum(unique_requests) AS `Unique Item Requests`,
       sum(unique_investigations) AS `Unique Item Investigations`,
       sum(total_requests) AS `Total Item Requests`
FROM ads_daily_counter_items_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND traffic = '${traffic}' AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw})
GROUP BY article_id ORDER BY `Unique Item Requests` DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: 丢失率与对账误差（按运行，只有合成数据）
panels.description: 对照模拟器真值：丢失率 = 1 − 入库去重后条数 ÷ 模拟器确认送达条数；误差 = Σ|ClickHouse − 真值| ÷ Σ真值。由模拟器的 reconcile 命令写入，不受两个开关影响。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT run AS `运行`, count() AS `天数`, sum(delivered) AS `送达`, sum(distinct_events) AS `入库去重后`,
       round(100 * (1 - sum(distinct_events) / nullIf(sum(delivered), 0)), 3) AS `丢失率 %`,
       round(100 * sum(viewers_abs_diff) / nullIf(sum(viewers_truth), 0), 3) AS `看过误差 %`,
       round(100 * sum(fulltext_abs_diff) / nullIf(sum(fulltext_truth), 0), 3) AS `读过全文误差 %`
FROM reconcile_results FINAL
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai')
GROUP BY run ORDER BY run

panels.title: 重复率（不受开关影响）
panels.description: 1 − 去重后条数 ÷ 写入行数（含重发）。写入行数取自 system.part_log（只留 7 天），更早的天为空。分不出合成与真实，不受开关影响。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time, 1 - distinct_events / written_rows AS duplicate_rate
FROM ads_daily_duplicates FINAL
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND written_rows > 0
ORDER BY day

panels.title: 迟到分布
panels.description: 服务端收到时刻 − 客户端产生时刻，按档计数；负值是客户端时钟比服务器快。不受「含爬虫」影响。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time,
       sumIf(events, lateness_bucket = 'clock_ahead') AS `客户端时钟超前`,
       sumIf(events, lateness_bucket = 'lt_1s') AS `< 1 秒`,
       sumIf(events, lateness_bucket = '1s_10s') AS `1～10 秒`,
       sumIf(events, lateness_bucket = '10s_60s') AS `10～60 秒`,
       sumIf(events, lateness_bucket = '1m_10m') AS `1～10 分钟`,
       sumIf(events, lateness_bucket = '10m_60m') AS `10～60 分钟`,
       sumIf(events, lateness_bucket = 'ge_1h') AS `≥ 1 小时`
FROM ads_daily_quality_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw})
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: 迟到分位数（秒）
panels.description: 迟到时长的分位数，浏览器与服务端分开（浏览器时钟可能不准）。不受「含爬虫」影响。数字最多晚 1 小时（ADS 表每小时重算最近两天）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time,
       quantilesMergeIf(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)(lateness_ms, source = 'client')[1] / 1000 AS `浏览器 p50`,
       quantilesMergeIf(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)(lateness_ms, source = 'client')[2] / 1000 AS `浏览器 p95`,
       quantilesMergeIf(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)(lateness_ms, source = 'client')[3] / 1000 AS `浏览器 p99`,
       quantilesMergeIf(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)(lateness_ms, source = 'server')[1] / 1000 AS `服务端 p50`,
       quantilesMergeIf(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)(lateness_ms, source = 'server')[2] / 1000 AS `服务端 p95`,
       quantilesMergeIf(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)(lateness_ms, source = 'server')[3] / 1000 AS `服务端 p99`
FROM ads_daily_quality_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND toDate($__toTime, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND is_synthetic IN (${synthetic:raw})
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: 坏数据量（events.dlq，不受开关影响）
panels.description: 每天进 events.dlq 的不合格事件，按原因分色（埋点方案 §5）。dlq 里读不出合成标记，不受开关影响。实时的采集拒收与入库滞后见「Analytics 管线」看板。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toDate(received_at, 'Asia/Shanghai'), 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time,
       countIf(reason_code = 'schema_invalid') AS schema_invalid,
       countIf(reason_code = 'unknown_event') AS unknown_event,
       countIf(reason_code = 'source_mismatch') AS source_mismatch,
       countIf(reason_code = 'version_rejected') AS version_rejected,
       countIf(reason_code = 'ingest_rejected') AS ingest_rejected
FROM dlq_events
WHERE received_at >= $__fromTime AND received_at <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
